g.text: Roofline: decoding lives on the memory-bound slope
H100 SXM figures: ~990 TFLOP/s dense bf16, ~3.35 TB/s HBM, giving a ridge point near 295 FLOP/byte. During decoding you read
every weight to produce one token per sequence, so arithmetic intensity is roughly the batch size. This single plot is the
argument for continuous batching, for GQA, for weight-only quantization, and for speculative decoding all at once.
